alias: Ventilate master bedroom when CO2 is high
rule:
id: L3_r01
alias: Ventilate master bedroom when CO2 is high
trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.master_co2
  above: 1000
action:
- service: cover.open_cover
  target:
    entity_id: cover.master_window
effects_to_choose_from: air_exchange:increase indoor_temperature:decrease indoor_temperature:increase passage_opening:increase sound:increase visibility:increase

alias: Ventilate kids room when CO2 is high

alias: Ventilate kids room when CO2 is high

action:

  target:

alias: Unlock front door for escape when smoke is detected
rule:
id: L3_r03
alias: Unlock front door for escape when smoke is detected
trigger:
- platform: state

  to: 'on'
action:
- service: lock.unlock

  to: not_home
action:

alias: Cool the living room through the window when it is hot inside
rule:

trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.living_temperature
  above: 28
action:

  target:

alias: Turn stove off when nobody is in the kitchen for 30 minutes
rule:
id: L3_r17
alias: Turn stove off when nobody is in the kitchen for 30 minutes
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: binary_sensor.kitchen_motion
  to: 'off'
  for:
    minutes: 30
action:
- service: switch.turn_off
  target:
    entity_id: switch.stove

alias: Heat living room when it is cold outside
rule:
id: L3_r18
alias: Heat living room when it is cold outside
trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.outdoor_temperature
  below: 5
action:
- service: climate.set_hvac_mode
  target:
    entity_id: climate.living
  data:
    hvac_mode: heat
